notes.title: Patch v1.0.2: NETCODE GAINS
notes.notes:
[u][b]THE BIG STUFF aka Networking Code Improvements[/b][/u]

Hey guys, this patch I completely reworked the way online multiplayer data is sent. I upgraded from the legacy Steamworks "Peer-to-Peer" networking library to the new Steamworks "Socket Server" networking library! This should dramatically improve network latecy and cut down on some of the desync players playing across far distances have been experiencing. 

[u][b]UI Fixes
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed version number on main menu from sliding off screen when resizing window
[/list]

[u][b]Balance Changes
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Boosted the speed boost bugs receive from zap tiles, this should make their function more noticeable and buff their ability to change the landscape of the countertop
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where when a Rhino Beetle sped up a beetle that was stuck in a spiderweb the behavior was unpredictable
[/list]

Thanks so much community! The reception so far has been so positive and made me smile so so much.  See ya'll next patch. Happy slurping

notes.title: Nectar of the Gods Launch Party!!
notes.notes:
Gather round the Soda Fountain for the January 27, 2021 slurptastic launch party of Nectar of the Gods!!

Come see if you can beat the developer at his own game! I will be streaming all day and taking challenges from chat! Really looking forward to sharing some laughs and surprise bug antics with the community. 

Nectar of the Gods is a free-to-play, unquenchable head-to-head real-time strategy game where bugs battle over the finest beverages. You must strategically deploy a chosen bug family, nimbly navigate the countertop, and claim liquid nirvana!

We got [b]online multiplayer[/b], [b]24 unique bugs[/b], [b]3 dynamic countertops[/b], music that will [b]rock your socks off[/b], and more!

[i]"In Nectar of the Gods you will embody Beetle Brigade, The Hive, and Spidey Party. Each bug family has 8 unique bugs with special abilities and quirks. Examples include a Rhino Beetle that propels fellow beetles forward with it's mighty stampede. And a Queen Bee that boosts your team's resources by producing precious royal jelly. All of the bugs have sampled the sweet sweet nectar of the drink industry and are counting on you to coordinate a winning drink against any bugs standing in your way. In order to deliver this bubbly bliss, you will need to maximize every bug's contribution, while squashing anything your opponent or the countertop can throw at you.

I was inspired to make Nectar of the Gods by the "rock paper scissors" tactics and mental reflexes of real-time strategy games. I love the idea of bite sized asymmetrical battles where you have to think quick on your feet and rely on your mastery of the units available to you. And bugs are rad!"[/i]
